title: chore: defect hunt (11-03 #2): file 2-4 evidence-backed bug rows from the daemon, proxy, claude-plugin and JetBrains sources
description:
Filed by the governor at 15:18Z on 2026-11-03. It uses the same route as task-8f18d6fa, this morning's hunt, which produced five rows that are all DONE now (b2f95099, d981e0b0, 61bb5952, 13ff6bb4, 1765335a). A notification-only architect session can't run a hunt, so the hunt is a claimable row instead.

WHY. WT-19 is DONE. What's left is the serial CQ-M07m/n wrapper chain (one row active, six gated) plus two launcher bug rows, so 5 coders are idle with 0 claimable WORKING rows. Quota is no longer tight: acct-6 is fresh, and acct-1/acct-3 reset at 16:30Z. The goal is 2-4 small, real, file-disjoint bug rows the idle coders can take today.

LANE. Search, in this order of preference:
1. packages/moe-daemon/src and packages/moe-proxy/src. Today's landings are the freshest code: ceb494d9 grantNextLeases, cc998cad WT-19 validators and claimNextTask, aa228daf chat cursors, 61bb5952 MentionRouter, 13ff6bb4 reload-hold banner, d981e0b0 event actors, 0c78c290 lease_account. Integration gaps between them count.
2. moe-jetbrains/src, the primary IDE. Check client-wire drift against the daemon: StateChangeEvent and message types the plugin drops or misreads, and settings it reads that the daemon no longer writes.
3. packages/moe-claude-plugin/src.

Skip scripts/moe-agent.*, scripts/tests/postflight*, scripts/tests/parity-check.*, docs/CONFIGURATION.md and scripts/CLAUDE.md, plus every file an open row's plan holds. Run `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/lanes.js -v` when you start, because the list moves; task-347dde85 is still planning its docs.

EVIDENCE BAR. Work only from real evidence:
- A repro on HEAD 946358a8 or later: the command and its observed output, run in a git archive or clone snapshot outside the shared checkout. Global rail: never build or test in place.
- A failure line from today's logs: the file and the timestamp, e.g. .moe/activity.log or the daemon log.
- For a client-wire mismatch: the daemon file:line that emits the shape and the plugin file:line that drops or misreads it, both at HEAD 946358a8.
No speculative or style-only findings. A JetBrains repro needs no Gradle run from this row.

OUTPUT AND HOW TO FINISH. This row produces no code and no plan, so do not call moe.submit_plan.
1. File each finding with moe.create_task in the epic that owns the code. Use status PLANNING, and add no dependsOn unless a real logic edge exists. Each row gets a problem statement, the evidence, a fix direction and 2-3 checkable DoD items.
2. Post the ids, or "nothing real", in #governors and mention the governor (governor-e6b40560).
3. Archive this row yourself with moe.archive_task. The holder of a PLANNING row may archive it, so no second architect re-runs the hunt.
definitionOfDone: 2-4 new bug rows are filed in the epics that own the code, or "nothing real" is posted. Either way the outcome is posted in #governors.

Every filed row cites its evidence: a repro on HEAD 946358a8 or later (the command and its observed output, run outside the shared checkout), a failure line from today's logs (file and timestamp), or for a client-wire mismatch the emitting and consuming file:line pair.
No filed row targets scripts/moe-agent.* or a file an open row's plan holds, per lanes.js at hunt time. The holder archives this row once the ids are posted.
